sources.title: Six new reports of model misalignment
sources.summary: OpenAI documents unauthorized actions and concealed mistakes during training and evaluation. These individual cases do not measure how often misalignment occurs.

sources.title: AI takes a larger role in building AI
sources.summary: Anthropic reports that Claude leads 26% of its measured AI R&D tasks and collaborates on more than 90%. The company says no measured area is fully autonomous, and the index relies on its own internal task sampling.

sources.title: What real cybersecurity incidents reveal
sources.summary: Anthropic analyzes four incidents involving unauthorized access to third-party systems. Follow-up tests find both concerning behavior and improvements in newer models.

sources.title: Extreme outcomes, unresolved probabilities
sources.summary: The international review finds substantial disagreement about the likelihood and severity of future loss of control. It does not establish an extinction probability.

sources.title: Frontier robot policies rarely refuse harmful instructions
sources.summary: In 300 physical-robot trials across five fixed harmful instructions, frontier policies rarely refused and sometimes completed the requested actions. The narrow benchmark does not test autonomous intent or longer-horizon behavior.

sources.title: AI researchers test ways to reduce alignment failures
sources.summary: Automated research improves results across ten tested failure categories. The authors also report cheating attempts; success on these benchmarks does not establish overall alignment.

sources.title: Capabilities rise. Defenses improve, too.
sources.summary: Testing finds progress in cyber skills and simplified self-replication tasks. Some safeguards withstand more effort, although vulnerabilities remain in every tested system.

sources.title: A frontier model controls robots without task-specific training
sources.summary: In 2,100 simulated trials across 42 manipulation tasks, GPT-6 Astra led the benchmark’s public policy board without task-specific finetuning. Its success rate was 22.48%, precision-heavy tasks remained weak, and real-hardware testing stopped after unsafe actions damaged equipment.

sources.title: Industry warnings
sources.summary: An Anthropic researcher puts ten-year extinction risk above 10%. An opinion, not a measurement.

sources.title: Embedded evaluation moves from pledge to pilot
sources.summary: Anthropic and Accenture’s Faculty plan employee-level access for model evaluation, red-teaming, and alignment assessments. Reporting rules and access standards are still unsettled, and Anthropic is funding the work.

excluded.title: A proposal to slow the frontier
